--- alter_locality_group_if_exists.sql
ALTER LOCALITY GROUP IF EXISTS `default` SET OPTIONS (storage = 'ssd')

--- AST
&ast.AlterLocalityGroup{
  IfExists: true,
  Name:     &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 31,
    NameEnd: 40,
    Name:    "default",
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 45,
    Rparen:  69,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 54,
          NameEnd: 61,
          Name:    "storage",
        },
        Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
          ValuePos: 64,
          ValueEnd: 69,
          Value:    "ssd",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER LOCALITY GROUP IF EXISTS `default` SET OPTIONS (storage = "ssd")
